headline: Portfolio Outperforms SPY YTD
summary: As of August 20, 2026, the portfolio set is outperforming the SPY benchmark with an average return of 23.86% compared to SPY's 12.57%. This outperformance translates to an average alpha of 11.29%, indicating that the portfolios are not only gaining in absolute terms but are also exceeding the benchmark's performance. The top portfolio, 'Random A', has delivered a notable return of 46.08%, significantly contributing to the overall performance. In contrast, the weakest portfolio, 'Random B', returned 9.12%, highlighting the variance in performance across the portfolios. This relative strength against SPY is particularly relevant during periods of market uncertainty, as it suggests resilience in the portfolio's composition. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
